claims.claim_text: On August 22, 2021, the subject had assaulted his wife, W-1, and their six-year-old son at the family residence.
I had been briefed that the subject had broken W-1's wrist during the altercation.
An anonymous tipster had warned that the subject was armed.
W-1 reported that while driving the school bus on Orangethorpe Avenue with students aboard, she observed the subject following her in a grey Chevrolet Tahoe.
The subject blocked the bus's path, exited his vehicle holding a chrome revolver, and aimed it at the bus.
W-1 stated the subject screamed verbal threats including death threats directed at her.
The subject fired at least one round in the direction of the bus.
The civilian vehicle was a white Honda Accord, and its driver sustained minor injuries.
I immediately observed the subject seated in the driver's seat with a black semi-automatic pistol visible in his left hand.
He walked slowly toward the officers with what I would describe as a resigned expression.
Total rounds fired: approximately eight by myself and six by Officer Cho.
Officers rendered first aid at 1413 hours.
I arrived in the parking lot approximately 90 seconds after the subject stopped.
I was operating in an undercover capacity in a personal vehicle near the intersection of Orangethorpe Avenue and Beach Boulevard.
